usedFor: ActivityInfo holds your program records, and Microsoft Excel receives each one as a row through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in ActivityInfo, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every record collected in a chosen form lands in an Excel table, ready for reporting.

watchOut: “New Record” is polling, so rows appear after a scheduled check, and “Updated Record” would add rows for edits too.
